name: boundary_lock.py
title: Three-frequency boundary-rank audit
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Builds the n-3 by 6 evaluation matrix [1,z^i,z^(2i),z^(5i),U_<5,L_>5]. The generated lower coefficients have three Fourier frequencies; for n>=9 the lower tail reduces modulo the first three evaluation columns to -L3*z^(3i)-L4*z^(4i)-L5*z^(5i). Thus rank is 4 plus the rank of [[U3,-L3],[U4,-L4]], explaining the boundary determinant test and the fixed nonzero Vandermonde ratio.
guards_and_contracts: The caller supplies a prime/primitive root and sufficiently long coefficient arrays. The fixed runner uses n=8,16,32,64, primes 12289/65537 and 50 alternating matched/unmatched draws. n=8 is deliberately exceptional because only five rows exist. samples<=1 can leave the ratio set empty and fail the generic-witness assertion; this is a diagnostic API limit, not evidence against the stored 50-sample witnesses.
costs: Matrix construction is quadratic in n as written because each row sums the long lower tail; modular exponentiation adds logarithmic exponent costs. Rank elimination has six columns; these are small research checks, not a fast Fourier evaluator.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: Checks rank<=5 iff U3*L4-U4*L3==0 only at n>=9 and records n=8 exceptions. Imported determinant/rank/root helpers are exact-hash identified, not re-executed. Existing independent receipt explicitly preserves an n=8 counterexample and reproduces the stored determinant ratios.

name: collapse_certificate.py
title: Cyclotomic 11-by-9 gate collapse
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Constructs four three-column evaluation blocks and one cofactor row in Z[zeta8][h0,h1,h2,h6]. Checks all 30 relevant four-by-four subspace determinants, ten Pluecker relations, and all 55 maximal minors. The ten allowed minors equal -DB_I*DH and 45 vanish. The irreducibility branch maps DB to a symmetric homogenized quadratic over F_12289 and requires the leading four-by-four determinant to equal nonzero 11251.
guards_and_contracts: Validity depends on the exact imported build(), sparse polynomial arithmetic, variable ordering and primitive root. A nonzero reduction of an integral cyclotomic determinant certifies nonzero characteristic-zero determinant; rank>=4 rules out a product of two linear forms. It does not show the quadric has no points, or remove exceptional parameter/saturation branches.
costs: Fixed-size symbolic elimination may have substantial monomial growth. It is a certificate calculation with no asymptotic transform evaluator or uniform fast-cost claim.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: Every maximal row choice is enumerated; the code does not merely sample minors. Imported dependency closure is not freshly reviewed in full. The stored independent symbolic audit supports the same collapse; the current review neither runs it nor promotes it to unrestricted Fourier feasibility.

name: lower_gate.py
title: Lower-stage rank gate and restricted finite-field search
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Forms the lower four-output-column intersection gate for N=8, with lower row windows 3..7 or 4..7. Cofactors of the final four-by-three block yield a scalar compatibility row. Positive controls derive Q=B*P^T*C^-1 from separated random stages and require gate rank<=8. The p=17 scan solves a restricted old polynomial chart before comparing upper and lower gates.
guards_and_contracts: The search skips h0=0, Delta=0 and t=0, then requires the old cubic and upper gate. Its conclusions concern that chart over the chosen field. It is not an exhaustive all-generator or all-field Fourier exclusion. Singular C is retried in positive controls; there is no outer retry limit. Other public arguments have no shape/permutation/prime validation.
costs: Search is p^4 parameter enumeration with fixed 8/11-row matrix work; positive controls seek 100 successes per prime. No practical FFT speed claim follows.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: The source has explicit positive controls and up to six lower-rejected witness records, but these two functions are not invoked by run_new.py. Stored ALL_NEW_VERIFIED therefore cannot be used as a run receipt for this file. No new stored witness failure was established.

name: minor_plane.py
title: Exploratory specialized minor plane
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Specializes h0=1,h1=0, renames h2/h6 and exactly builds the same 11-by-9 cofactor gate. It evaluates four chosen maximal minors on that slice and prints sparse size/degree information.
guards_and_contracts: The polynomial monomial format and exact algebra are imported assumptions. specialize() assumes only the four intended variables; arbitrary higher variable IDs would be folded into its second retained variable. This is an internal chart helper, not a checked generic substitution API.
costs: Fixed-size symbolic determinants with possible coefficient/term growth; four samples do not exhaust 55 minors or all parameter charts.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: There are no assertions of a new exclusion in main(). Its printed degrees/term counts are exploratory diagnostics. No execution or stored theorem evidence is inferred from their existence.

name: permutation_screen.py
title: Permutation-only bilateral screening
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Computes the maximum prefix/suffix rank-sum lower bound and enumerates every permutation for n=6,7,8. At n=8 it asserts exactly 28584 pass rank sum two. Larger n=16,32,64 use 10000 fixed-seed random permutations each.
guards_and_contracts: required_ranksum assumes a genuine permutation of length>=2 and otherwise may misclassify or raise on max(empty). The only call sites meet this contract. A pass is only a necessary rank filter; the output disclaimer correctly distinguishes sampled counts from exhaustive counts.
costs: Repeated slices and min/max scans make one profile O(n^2) elementary work. Exact enumeration is factorial; Monte Carlo is 10000 such profiles per listed size.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: The exact count agrees as stored with the later window screen and independent window audit. Larger zero/pass rates cannot prove emptiness or general factorization existence.

name: prior_loader.py
title: Prior-checkpoint extraction loader
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: If one sentinel source is absent, CRC-tests and extracts a bundled previous ZIP, then prepends its expected root to sys.path. Importing callers invokes this mutating loader before the actual mathematics.
guards_and_contracts: A preexisting exact_polynomial_gate.py sentinel suppresses extraction without verifying the remainder of the directory or its content hashes. CRC verifies ZIP consistency, not an externally trusted identity. The function has no explicit cumulative-size, depth, duplicate-name or symlink policy. No exploit or corrupted stored archive is alleged.
costs: Extraction and retained prior trees are setup/I/O and storage costs. Reuse assumes a correct prepared directory.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: Exact bundled helper hashes and the follow-on _bootstrap path mutation were inspected inertly. Runtime sys.path binding and module-cache effects remain unexecuted. This loader is not itself mathematical validation.

name: rank_uncertainty_gate.py
title: Bilateral Fourier rank uncertainty regressions
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Audits Fourier annihilation of t-character subspaces, Vandermonde restriction ranks, and the lower-bound inequality for sampled full-column-rank X, with mirror low-frequency cases. It also checks the P8 rank-sum profile, larger fixed suffix shuffles, and four exact three-by-three determinant constants.
guards_and_contracts: The abstract theorem needs invertible C, the given oriented quasiseparable rank bounds, the stated Fourier endpoint convention and a primitive root in a field of characteristic not dividing n. The supplied lengths and primes satisfy the intended dyadic regime through imported root generation. Arbitrary endpoint input reorderings are not licensed.
costs: Dense F and X/H products and Gaussian ranks dominate polynomial diagnostic cost. Python pow calls and field bit costs are separate; the return value explicitly says no runtime improvement.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: Finite fixed sizes/draws do not prove the all-length theorem on their own. The independent stored proof/receipt supplies broader checks and keeps the n=8 surviving boundary separate from n>=9 rejection for suffix (1,2,5).

name: run_new.py
title: New-gate aggregation runner
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Calls exact collapse, quadratic irreducibility, bilateral rank audit, boundary audit and permutation screen, then writes ALL_NEW_VERIFIED.json and prints its digest.
guards_and_contracts: The imports trigger the prior loader and would execute source setup. It does not call lower_gate.py or minor_plane.py. Imported asserts may be disabled by optimized Python; no self-contained dependency/hash validation is performed here.
costs: Costs are the sum of those symbolic, dense and factorial/sample audits. Timing is diagnostic only.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: ALL NEW refers to its explicit five-call selection, not complete source coverage, all archived experiments or a faster FFT. The current review did not execute it.

name: audit.py
title: Phase22 fixed-pair audit reporter
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Reconstructs 24 pairs of two-term weighted cyclic Green sums, forms exact bilinear Gram data, and records 12 synthetic dense positive controls with known phase/permutation. It records statuses and recovery counts.
guards_and_contracts: The reporter does not assert all negative pairs are excluded or all positives recovered. An unexpected failed status can still yield process exit zero and a report. Its fixed model parameters satisfy the intended shape contract; arbitrary Green sums can be singular and fail inversion.
costs: Dense reconstruction uses N basis oracle calls per matrix, O(q*N^2) scalar work for O(qN) applies, followed by cubic dense inversion/multiplication. The literal O(N^2) oracle-operations label conflates calls with scalar work.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: Stored audit.json actually reports 24 exclusions and 12 recoveries, matching the independent stored receipt field by field. The tests assert those outcomes, so the weak reporting exit status does not by itself invalidate these stored samples.

name: phase22_gram.py
title: Phase22 exact Gram screen and weighted-cycle evaluator
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Implements finite-field DFT/linear algebra, the necessary congruence C=B^-T*J*B^-1=P^T*Q*K*Q*P, squared-entry fingerprints, unique row-signature permutation recovery and rank-one ratio mask reconstruction. WeightedCyclicGreen solves the cyclic recurrence by affine prefix products and a nonsingular closure denominator, then gathers/scatters through an arbitrary cycle and gauges.
guards_and_contracts: root() checks supported dyadic lengths; sqrt_mod rejects nonsquares; invert() rejects singular matrices. Fingerprints preserve zero-diagonal inconclusive and repeated-signature ambiguous branches. recover_mask refuses any zero K entry and verifies the final equation but assumes a genuine permutation and intended invertible/symmetric form inputs. WeightedCyclicGreen.prepare validates order and holonomy, but not vector/weights/gauge lengths; GreenSum assumes nonempty same-size terms. These generic API gaps do not occur in stored fixed-size constructors.
costs: Prepared cycle apply O(N) and q-term sum O(qN), O(N) workspace; preparation O(N) plus inversion. Dense Gram and positive-control construction O(N^3) and O(N^2) storage; fingerprint row sorting O(N^2 log N); mask reconstruction O(N^2) field inversions. Finite p=998244353 supports dyadic n<=2^23, not unbounded-N uniform asymptotics.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: Tests include Gram-not-Fourier and ambiguity controls, cycle equations, reflection identity and exact positive recovery. Bilinear transpose is correct and must not be silently replaced by conjugate transpose. The stored samples support only those fixed pairs; no universal complex Green-sum no-go or sub-NlogN evaluator is accepted.

name: phase22_parity.py
title: Phase22 parity factorization and covariance gate
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Builds F=H*Q*C with reflection-pair H, 1/-i diagonal Q and real-cosine/sine formal residual. apply_H/apply_Ht match the explicit ordering. apply_R builds paired rotations; real_covariance_gate checks the seed and sampled C*Z=R*C equations.
guards_and_contracts: Dense parity_factors validates dyadic n>=4; public apply_H/Ht and several helper paths lack equivalent length guards. The oracle test assumes a fixed correctly sized linear map; zip comparison does not itself enforce output length, seed is deterministic, and trials may be zero/negative. Such calls cannot furnish the claimed independent-random linear-map soundness. Stored controls use correct sizes, two trials and explicitly linear dense oracles.
costs: The advertised O(N) apply_R work is not delivered by this implementation: real_rotation_coefficients recomputes positive and negative powers for every j, yielding O(N log N) ordinary field multiplication work each call. The assigned linear_rotation_reference supplies the recurrence-based repair. Dense creation remains cubic, residual entropy numerical/quadratic, and materializing C is not a fast evaluator.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: The test suite checks complete matrices/orthogonality plus sampled covariance and rejects a scalar-normalization error. Fixed-seed covariance acceptance is a regression result, not proof or an adversarial certificate. These limitations and the cost defect were already recognized in the historical independent Phase22 audit.

name: test_phase22.py
title: Phase22 exact/numerical regression suite
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Contains 12 test methods covering reflection, cycle equations, hidden phase/permutation, fixed negative pairs, Gram insufficiency, fingerprint ambiguity, real-positive Gram examples, numerical real/imaginary ranks, parity and covariance/normalization.
guards_and_contracts: numpy numerical controls have explicit error/rank tolerances and are not exact-complex proofs. unittest.main() is at line 130, before ParityReduction and RealCovariance, so direct script execution normally exits after only the eight earlier tests. Discovery imports the full module and includes all 12.
costs: Dense matrices and cubic products/inversions make this a small-size verifier; entropy reaches 256, exact matrix tests reach 128.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: RUN.md and verify_full_lineage.py prescribe discovery, and tests_phase22.log actually names all 12 methods including the four later ones. The direct-entry omission is concrete but does not overturn that stored discovery log. Tests were not run in this review.

name: verify_full_lineage.py
title: Phase22 fresh-extraction lineage runner
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Extracts an outer ZIP, verifies each listed manifest entry, launches unittest discovery and audit.py, then extracts and runs the nested Phase21 lineage validator. It rejects nonzero return codes and has explicit subprocess timeouts.
guards_and_contracts: Listed-file hashes are checked, but unlisted files/import shadows and absolute/parent-relative manifest paths are not explicitly screened; the manifest and payload share the same untrusted archive rather than an external anchor. Most checks are asserts. Its final 12+222=234 text is hardcoded, not a parsed count.
costs: Repeated extraction, fresh subprocesses and inherited dense suites are research/lineage costs, not forward-transform costs.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: The audit.py subprocess exit code alone does not require 24/12 outcomes, whereas the preceding discovery tests do assert them. Stored logs show the intended discovery route and inherited totals, but no fresh run or complete transitive source review is claimed.

name: linear_rotation_reference.py
title: Independent linear-work rotation reference
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Prepares rotation coefficients by advancing omega and inverse-omega multiplicatively, then applies the fixed 2-by-2 rotations in one linear pass. It preserves the Phase22 parity basis ordering and endpoint signs.
guards_and_contracts: Checks n is a multiple of four, omega^n=1, the fourth-phase square=-1, and vector length. The documented caller must supply a primitive root in an appropriate field: these tests are not a complete primitivity or primality test for arbitrary composite n/modulus. Stored Phase22 calls use valid dyadic field instances; no defective stored control is shown.
costs: O(N) coefficient preparation/storage and O(N) application after root/inverse preparation; field setup, modular inversion and bit arithmetic remain charged separately. It does not evaluate C itself.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: This addresses the source cost issue without changing the mathematical covariance identity. Standalone source contains no tests; historical independent controls and report support its intended role. No execution was performed here.

name: run_independent_audits.py
title: Independent-auditor subprocess aggregator
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: At top level, sequentially runs five relative independent audit scripts, captures stdout/stderr, writes a failure receipt at the first nonzero exit, and otherwise writes a hardcoded uploaded_programs_executed=False success receipt.
guards_and_contracts: Importing the file would execute all five tasks. There is no timeout or pin validation before launching children. Source labels saying independent do not authorize execution during the current inert review. Output truth depends on exact child behavior, not the hardcoded flag.
costs: Total child audit runtime and captured output/storage; no transform computation is offered.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: All five target files were hash-identified. Several remain outside completed full-source coverage; this runner alone provides neither their coverage nor a transitive no-execution proof. Existing historical execution records remain historical.

name: audit_provenance.py
title: Nested archive provenance auditor
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Reads supplied outer archives and recursively inventories ZIP member bytes, validates embedded SHA256SUMS, compares hashes against a prior content set, and writes new-unique/manifest/provenance JSON records.
guards_and_contracts: Rejects duplicate member names, absolute/parent paths, POSIX symlinks, excessive nesting and cumulative declared uncompressed size through asserts. Outer size is compared with identity metadata, while its digest is recorded rather than checked against an external expected digest. Version is read from xattrs or defaults to zero. No archive member is executed or extracted by this source, but output JSON files are written.
costs: I/O/hashing proportional to recursively visited byte occurrences; nested identical archives are not memoized and count repeatedly toward the 250MB budget. Recursion/decompression cost is research provenance work.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: This provides integrity evidence, not authenticity, source review or mathematical acceptance. Its independent-authorship/no-execution claims are reconciled with its actual read-only-member control flow but it was not run now.

name: independent_checks.py
title: Independent root-free order-two recurrence auditor and evaluator
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Own standard-library implementation prepares dyadic field roots, direct Horner and recursive radix-two references, geometric resolvents, sparse differences and a root-free recurrence evaluator. infer_recurrence2 handles zero/rank-one cases, then uses the first four entries and verifies every recurrence equation. recurrence2 uses (1-u*t-v*t^2)X(t)=(x0-xN)+(x1-u*x0-v*x[N-1])*t at t^N=1, batch-inverts regular denominators and directly evaluates at most two exceptional frequencies.
guards_and_contracts: The recognizer is complete for length>=4 order<=2 recurrence: after rank-one rejection, determinant zero cannot represent a genuine second-order recurrence. Engine constructor asserts valid supported dyadic n; adaptive entry checks length. Raw helper methods assume consistent dimensions and nonnegative difference order. synthesize silently zips nodes/weights; test callers use matching lengths. Assertions are certificate checks and cannot be relied on with -O.
costs: Recognition, verification, root table, regular evaluation, at most two O(N) exceptional Horner sums, parity conversion and all writes give O(N) field work/storage on the accepted path after field setup. Arbitrary input uses recursive O(N log N) FFT; slices can add allocation work. Sparse difference path costs O((order+support)N) plus N exponentiations in order; fixed low order is its tested regime. Hankel/binary exhaustive audits are exponential diagnostics.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: Stored CHECK_RESULTS records 36 recurrence and 42 adaptive cases through 8192, including repeated/irreducible/zero roots and exceptions, direct/FFT controls, 174762 Hankel matrices and 69904 binary words. Those are historical results, not new runs. The root-free path is materially broader than source distinct-exponential recognition but does not improve arbitrary-input worst case.

name: audit.py
title: Phase23 Hankel/transition and adaptive audit reporter
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Implements independent GF2 Hankel elimination and cyclic transition enumeration; asserts full rank distributions m=1..9 and transition counts N=4,8,12,16. It separately calls phase23_resolvent for sampled working-field ranks and specified two-exponential adaptive cases.
guards_and_contracts: GF2 integer determinant parity can imply nonzero characteristic-zero determinant, but the code correctly does not infer nonzero rank over arbitrary other primes. The adaptive cases assert only selected method, then record a checksum; this alone is not all-output equality. The full tests and independent auditor give stronger comparisons.
costs: Exponential GF2/binary enumeration, dense cubic working-field ranks, and O(N) accepted structured paths through 8192. Fixed-field root/preparation/bit charges remain separate.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: Own counting routines are independent; importing the source resolver means the entire audit is not independent of uploaded implementation. Stored audit JSON equality with audit_output.txt is data consistency, not proof of execution or runtime equivalence.

name: test_phase23.py
title: Phase23 24-method regression suite
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Uses a separately implemented iterative radix-two NTT plus parity conversion to test resolvents, all root frequencies, exponential mixtures, inversion, Hankel barriers, inverse row sparsity, adaptive recognition/fallback, repeated-pole rejection, sparse differences and binary distributions.
guards_and_contracts: Reference implementation shares imported field/root/sqrt conventions, so it is algorithmically distinct but not dependency independent. All positive tests use supported dimensions; no broad malformed input, wrong engine length or composite modulus matrix is present. unittest.main() at line 108 precedes 15 methods across four later classes; direct script execution sees only nine initial methods.
costs: References are O(N log N), dense Hankel tests cubic and enumeration exponential. Most large examples are bounded to 4096; finite samples are not all-input proofs.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: RUN.md and lineage runner use discovery, which includes all 24 methods. Repeated-pole tests intentionally select the original fallback; they do not contradict the separate root-free extension. No direct-mode omission is asserted to invalidate discovery-based historical results.

name: verify_full_lineage.py
title: Phase23 recursive lineage runner
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Extracts and manifest-checks Phase23, runs discovery and audit.py, compares regenerated audit.json with stored audit_output.txt, then runs the nested Phase22 validator. Return codes/timeouts guard subprocess failures.
guards_and_contracts: Manifest path and dependency authenticity limitations match Phase22; final 24+234=258 count is a hardcoded label. recorded/recomputed variable names are reversed relative to the temporal role of overwritten audit.json, but equality is symmetric and this does not break the check. The output file is compared as parsed JSON, appropriately ignoring insignificant whitespace.
costs: Nested extraction and inherited regression runtime are charged verification work only.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: The two stored audit JSON payloads compare equal. The nested Phase22 archive hash agrees with the direct Phase22 family. No subprocess was launched in this review and this wrapper is not a full dependency-coverage certificate.

name: finite_field_audit.py
title: General and Fourier-specific finite-field window controls
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Implements modular ranks/inverse and the general necessary lower bound t-|H|+rank(M[R,H]). Cooley-Tukey endpoint controls verify actual factorization and rank-one stages, then demonstrate where substituting full Vandermonde rank is wrong. Separate natural-column/arbitrary-row and affine-input controls validate the restricted substitution; random rank-one-updated stages exercise general inequalities.
guards_and_contracts: prim_root tests n/2 only, which is adequate for the dyadic lengths actually used, not generic composite n. NumPy int64 modular products can overflow for large parameters; here p<=65537,n<=64 gives n*(p-1)^2<=274877906944, below 2^63, and elimination products are likewise safe. Public generalized_necessary assumes valid dimensions/permutations/rank budgets and actual stage hypotheses.
costs: All-window dense rank testing is polynomial research cost, potentially O(N^5) if every O(N^3) rank is recomputed for O(N^2) windows. It is no forward FFT evaluator.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: Stored endpoint controls use actual ranks 4 vs naive 5 at N8 and 8 vs 9 at N16, preserving corrected budget 2 vs naive 3. The independent audit agrees on these witnesses. No overflow or nonprimitive-root failure affects the stored cases.

name: run_all.py
title: Window research aggregate runner
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: On import/direct execution, enumerates N8, records combinatorial ceilings and a supplied N16 screen survivor, runs the finite-field audit, then invokes unittest test_window_gate.
guards_and_contracts: Top-level side effects include result writes and source execution. It asserts subprocess success, but enumeration and finite-field work are repeated inside the test suite and no subprocess timeout is used. N16 pass remains explicitly necessary-only.
costs: Repeated factorial screen and dense field audits dominate verification cost.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: SCREEN_RESULTS is written before later audits/tests finish, so the presence of that file alone is not a complete aggregate success receipt. Stored reports are consistent with the later test expectations; no aggregate run was performed here.

name: test_window_gate.py
title: Window rank regression suite
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Eight test methods check complete N8 counts, the identity permutation rejection, source ceilings, N16 survivor, Cooley-Tukey endpoint controls, natural/affine Vandermonde checks and random general-rank controls.
guards_and_contracts: It exercises only positive dimension/rank-budget inputs, and its direct unittest main is correctly at the end. The controls imported from finite_field_audit share the exact external ct_reference_control dependency, so this is not a fully independent reconstruction.
costs: Factorial N8 enumeration and repeated dense exact rank computations, finite test sizes only.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: Stored counts 40320/28584/15728/12856 and 3096 random general inequalities agree with its expectations. The separate independent window audit uses a different 1620 general-check count and does not contradict 3096, because the sample design differs.

name: prior_window_gate.py
title: Natural-order window rank filter
mathematical_scope_and_dataflow: Evaluates three head/tail/hull inequalities for every output interval while updating its permuted label extrema. It encodes the conditional Fourier Vandermonde screen, its coarse marker ceiling, exhaustive N8 enumeration and Monte Carlo larger screens.
guards_and_contracts: Permutation/window checks are asserts; rank budgets are assumed nonnegative integer bounds and are not validated. Empty permutations pass check_windows vacuously, outside the Fourier model. Natural/affine-coprime input order is essential; arbitrary output rows are permitted. The N16 stored permutation is a filter witness only.
costs: check_windows is O(N^2) plus initial O(N log N) sorting and can materialize O(N^2) violations. The older profile is O(N^2); exact N8 enumeration is factorial. combinatorial_ceiling is an O(1) necessary bound, not a construction.
tests_and_stored_witness_impact: The stored source returns rank-one ceiling 21 (9r^2+9r+3). A historical independent proof sharpens this filter to N<=16 at r=1; the weaker source bound remains correct, not a code error. Necessary-only and sampled-not-proof warnings are explicit.
